scope: native ProjectFileContent shell (not full application startup)

qualification.statistics: All finite raw ms from explicitly selected formal runs, including over_budget and any recorded failures with separate validityIssues; no rounding, trimming or outlier removal. Median uses midpoint for even n; p95 is nearest rank ceil(0.95*n). refs align with rawms.
qualification.processAndCache: Matrix declares serial fresh native processes, visible incognito WebViews, OS caches retained. This is process-cold, not machine/OS-cache-cold. Machine/cache facts are copied from matrices, not inferred from the generator host.
qualification.acceptance: Performance readiness only. Optional autosave/edit/race/history/Workspace acceptance is not established by this artifact.
qualification.clocks: shell/document performance marks use separate document time origins; no cross-document subtraction. null marks means field absent; [] means captured with no matching marks.
qualification.workerJoin: Request IDs and both independent cumulative clocks retained from logs. No ordering-based join to JS commands without shared requestId. Parallel/overlapping phase durations are not added.
qualification.fixtures: V2 manifest and present fixture bytes verified. Native raw reports do not persist source-byte hashes; matching current workspace bytes does not prove historical bytes. Corrected large Word selected explicitly.
